prompt_template: high fantasy pixel art of a single {desc}, Final Fantasy aesthetic, hyper-detailed, rich saturated colors, detailed shading, one isolated specimen tree, side profile view, the trunk rises from the bottom and the full height and side silhouette are visible from base to crown; the roots meet the bottom against FULLY TRANSPARENT pixels — absolutely NO ground disc, grass mound, dirt platform, base pad, soil patch, terrain tile, or ground block under or around the base; pure transparency on all four sides; no other plants or scenery; not a top-down overhead view; not a flat radial canopy disc; not a square texture tile; not multiple trees
